# Sven Haase

> Portfolio of Sven Haase, a fullstack developer from Much (Rhein-Sieg district, near Cologne/Bonn), Germany. He combines Angular frontends with Python backends, is currently focused on Python development, and is open to remote work and to relocating.

Sven builds web applications with Angular, TypeScript and Firebase on the frontend and Python on the backend. His motto is "Impossible is nothing": he looks for efficient, scalable solutions to technical problems, enjoys collaborative teams and likes turning complex problems into clean code.

The website is a single-page Angular application in English and German, with a language switch in the navigation. Its sections are About me, Skill set, My work, References and Contact (a contact form).

Skill set: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, RxJS, Vue.js, Material Design, WordPress, REST APIs, Python, Django, Flask, SQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Firebase, Supabase, Docker, Heroku, Cloud, Linux, Git, Scrum, and a growth mindset.

References from colleagues on the Pokedex, Join and El Pollo Loco projects describe him as a reliable, friendly and structured team player who writes clear code and handles deadline pressure well.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://svenhaase.de/): Start page with the About me, Skill set, My work, References and Contact sections
- [Legal notice](https://svenhaase.de/imprint): Imprint and terms of use
- [Privacy policy](https://svenhaase.de/privacy): How personal data is handled (hosting at netcup, contact form)

## Projects

- [Videoflix](https://videoflix.svenhaase.de/): Backend for a video streaming platform with email activation, JWT login in HttpOnly cookies, password reset and background conversion of uploads to HLS (480p, 720p, 1080p) with FFmpeg; Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/Videoflix))
- [Quizly](https://quizly.svenhaase.de/): Backend that turns a YouTube video into a multiple-choice quiz: local transcription with Whisper AI, quiz generation with Google Gemini Flash; Python, Django REST Framework, JWT ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/Quizly))
- [Coderr](https://coderr.svenhaase.de/): Backend for a freelancer marketplace where business users publish offers in three packages and customers book and review them; Python, Django REST Framework, token authentication ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/coderr))
- [KanMind](https://kanmind.svenhaase.de/): Backend for a Kanban board with boards, members, tasks, reviewers and comments; Python, Django REST Framework, token authentication, object-level permissions ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/KanMind))
- [DaBubble](https://dabubble.svenhaase.de/): Slack-inspired team chat with real-time messaging, direct messages, channels, threads and emoji reactions; Angular, TypeScript, Firebase Auth and Firestore; team project ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/dabubble-2))
- [PollApp](https://pollapp.svenhaase.de/): Create and share live polls with real-time evaluation of the results; Angular, TypeScript, Firebase ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/pollapp))
- [Shooter](https://shooter.svenhaase.de/): 3D first-person shooter in the browser where you can also drive a car or fly a broomstick; Angular, Three.js, TypeScript ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/3d-shooter))
- [Sauerei](https://sauerei.web.app): Arcade game in the style of Moorhuhn (Crazy Chicken) with a fast, simple game mechanic; Angular, TypeScript ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/Sau))
- [EasyTV](https://easy-tv.org/): Kodi fork and multimedia player with an integrated webview and adblocker for Android, Windows and Linux; Java, JavaScript, C++, Python ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/easy-tv_Windows))
- [Join](https://join.svenhaase.de/): Kanban task manager with drag and drop, ticket assignment and categories; JavaScript, HTML, CSS ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/join))
- [El Pollo Loco](https://epl.svenhaase.de/): Object-oriented jump-and-run browser game with coin collecting, throwable objects and a final boss fight; JavaScript, HTML, CSS ([source](https://github.com/SiriusSagittarius/EL_POLLO_LOCO))
